title: The Ultimate Aberration Resource Guide, 50+ Tips/Locations, Ark Survival Ascended
description:
Welcome to this comprehensive Ark: Survival Ascended Aberration Resource Location guide! In this walkthrough, we will cover everything you need to know to progress in this challenging environment of ASA Aberration. I will be showing you how to find resources on Aberration. We will be looking at: 

Metal locations, Crystal locations, gem locations, obsidian locations, element ore locations, cementing paste location, silica pearl locations, oil locations, rare flower locations, rare mushroom locations, bio toxin locations, mushrooms locations, giant bee honey locations and more.
